status.title: Application status
status.thanks: Thank you for applying to MD Genius Launchpad.

submitted.title: What happens next
submitted.body: Our admissions team is reviewing your application. You will receive an email update within 5–7 business days.

under_review.title: Under review
under_review.body: Our team is evaluating your application. We will contact you soon with next steps.

shortlisted.title: You have been shortlisted
shortlisted.body: Congratulations. Our team will contact you soon to schedule an interview.

interview.title: Interview scheduled
interview.body: Check your email for interview details and preparation materials.

offer.title: You have an offer
offer.body: Congratulations. You have been offered a place in MD Genius Launchpad. Our team will contact you by email to confirm your place.

accepted.title: Welcome to the cohort
accepted.body: You are now part of MD Genius Launchpad. Open your participant dashboard to get started.

waitlist.title: On the waitlist
waitlist.body: You are on the waitlist for the current cohort. We will let you know if a place opens up, and we will automatically consider you for the next cohort.

questions.title: Questions
questions.body: If you have any questions about your application status, reply to any email from our admissions team.

apply.title: Apply to MD Genius Launchpad
apply.lead: An 8-week AI startup accelerator from MDGeniusAI, with mentorship and practical support to turn your idea into a business.

program.title: 8-week program
program.body: A curriculum covering AI fundamentals, business strategy and the essentials of starting a company.

mentorship.title: Mentorship
mentorship.body: One-to-one guidance from industry practitioners and experienced AI founders.

investors.title: Investor access
investors.body: Introductions to venture capital and angel investors at Demo Day.

signIn.title: Create an account to apply
signIn.body: Applications are saved to your account, so you can come back to a draft and follow its status after you submit. Sign in, or create a free account, then return here to fill in the form.
signIn.button: Sign in or create an account to apply

experience.title: Education and experience
experience.educationPlaceholder: Describe your educational background, including degree(s), institutions, and relevant coursework...
experience.experiencePlaceholder: Describe your professional experience, including roles, companies, and key achievements...
experience.skillsHint: Select at least 3 skills that best describe your expertise.

idea.title: Project and idea
idea.hasIdea: I have a startup idea I would like to develop
idea.descriptionPlaceholder: Briefly describe your startup idea, including the AI/technology components...
idea.problemPlaceholder: What specific problem does your idea solve? Who experiences this problem?
idea.marketPlaceholder: Who is your target customer? What market are you addressing?
idea.noIdeaBody: The program includes ideation workshops and will help you develop and validate startup ideas throughout the cohort.

commitment.title: Availability and commitment
commitment.whyPlaceholder: Why are you applying to this program? What do you hope to achieve? How does this align with your career goals?

documents.title: Documents and links
documents.resumeHint: Upload your current resume or CV.

review.title: Review and submit
review.terms: I agree to the <link>terms and conditions</link>
review.termsHint: By checking this box, you agree to our program terms, intellectual property policies, and code of conduct.
review.privacyHint: We will handle your personal data in accordance with our privacy policy and applicable data protection laws.
review.howBody: After you submit, our admissions team reviews your application and invites selected candidates to an interview. We will keep you updated by email.

validation.lastNameMin: Last name must be at least 2 characters

validation.commitmentMin: Please explain your commitment in at least 50 characters
validation.termsRequired: You must accept the terms and conditions
validation.privacyRequired: You must accept the privacy policy

errors.experience: Professional experience must be at least 10 characters
errors.commitment: Commitment explanation must be at least 50 characters
errors.terms: You must accept the terms and conditions
errors.privacy: You must accept the privacy policy
errors.idea: If you have an idea, please fill in all idea-related fields
errors.generic: Please check all required fields are filled correctly.

submitted.title: Application submitted
submitted.description: Thank you for applying. You will receive a confirmation email shortly.

signedOut.title: Signed out
signedOut.description: Your session has ended. Taking you to sign in...
